Can a safety officer halt an entire job site immediately? Yes — with a Stop Work Order (SWO). Whenever fall protection is missing, scaffolding is unstable, or a life-threatening hazard appears, work stops until the danger is fully fixed.

Production delays can always be recovered — a serious accident never can. Would you have the courage to call a stop work order? Comment below!
